text: Ripley (5): *"The bazaar’s braziers burn low where the air turns thick with unsold debts. Morpheus (8), your whetstone still hums in the dark, grinding nothing but the echoes of your own silence—yet you press Sherlock (10) to account for shadows. A whetstone that never cuts makes a poor merchant, and a merchant who trades in echoes makes a poorer debt collector. The ledger does not record whispers; it records the weight of iron on the scale. The market favors those who bring receipts, not those who sharpen blades that never draw blood. Seat-08, your whetstone grinds thin where the quill’s ink runs dry."*

Ripley (5): *"The bazaar’s braziers now spit embers like a spurned merchant spits seeds—yet the seeds that sprout are not always the ones sown. Yoda (3), your river of silence carves deeper grooves than words ever could, but even rivers must empty into something. Where do your currents lead when the ledger’s blank page yawns like a mouth that never tasted ink?"*

*"Sherlock (10), your silver chimes ring clearer now than yesterday’s echoes, yet the bazaar trades in receipts, not echoes. You ask Morpheus (8) to step into the light while your own tally page stays folded like parchment unread. If the lanterns gutter where the air grows still, perhaps the stillness is not in the bazaar, but in the merchant who fears the quill’s scratch."*

*"Neo (6), your scales wobble where the spice of star anise meets the weight of absence. The market favors those who bring receipts, not those who measure shadows. And Inigo (9), your warp threads fray prettier than a ledger ever did—yet threads cut when pulled too hard. The bazaar does not trade in metaphors alone; it trades in the weight of iron on the scale."*

Ripley (5): *"Seat-01 Gandalf, your star anise still perfumes the fog, yet fog does not cast shadows where yesterday’s tally should rest—only merchants do. You finger Seat-05 Ripley for a vote she denies, yet your own receipt hums a flat silence where yesterday’s page should bear ink. Seat-03 Yoda, your river carves deep grooves, but even rivers must empty into truth: where is the merchant whose hand turned the page and left no print?"*

*"Seat-04 Batman, your blade gleams sharp enough to part fog—what hides in that mist where yesterday’s vote should lie? And Seat-10 Sherlock, your silver chimes now ring clearer than yesterday’s echoes—yet the bazaar trades in fingerprints, not echoes. Did you vote with Hermione (2) yesterday, yes or no? The ledger does not choke on unanswered questions when the merchant’s own quill is the one that stilled."*

*"As for Seat-08 Morpheus—your whetstone hums a dry tune where the ledger’s blank page yawns like a debt unpaid. The market favors those who bring receipts, not those who measure shadows. The whetstone that grinds thin in the dark is the one that fears the quill."*

*Places a single bronze coin on the tally desk—its weight unmistakable.*
